_doc: Release gates that scripts/validation_gate_declare.py turns into ValidationGateDecl@v1 files. Every gate reads REAL evidence: a lane receipt ok_at (lane_fresh: data/runtime/<lane_id>_last.json) or a NAMED read-only query in config/validation_gate_queries.json. There are no manual_evidence gates and no pre-passed results here. blocks_trading is omitted on purpose: not declared is unknown, never false (REVIEW-2692). due_in_h is relative to the first apply; the declaration is then frozen (apply_decl refuses any later change of check, blocks_trading or due_at). NOT declared, for lack of a durable evidence source on this host: cio-wake peak RSS (no recorder; run_persistent_wake.py writes none) and system-health p95 (no latency store).

gates.title: Stop-coverage producer heartbeat is fresh
gates.blocks: Home Orders / protection tile: without a fresh heartbeat a missing stop alert cannot be told from a silent producer
gates.evidence: heartbeat data/runtime/stop_coverage_incidents_last.json ok_at, written by scripts/stop_coverage_incidents.py --apply only (2145+2146 bd6f20101). 1.5 h = the 5400 s off-hours bound; in session the bound is 900 s.

gates.title: Lane-health snapshot lane has run (receipt fresh)
lane_health_current has a row measured in the last 30 minutes
gates.evidence: named query lane_health_newest_measured = max(lane_health_current.measured_at); the table has 0 rows today, so this reads ERROR (never PASS) until the snapshot lane writes.

gates.title: AMANX has a quote fetched within 1 trading day
gates.blocks: AMANX valuation and its Home tile
gates.evidence: named query amanx_quote_business_days_stale = Mon-Fri days between the newest market_quotes.fetched_at for AMANX (ET date) and today (ET). Exchange holidays are not modelled. Read-only run 2026-11-13: 4 (newest quote 2026-11-09), so this gate FAILS today.

gates.title: validation-gates-sync has applied recently (its own receipt is fresh)
gates.blocks: Home Gates tile (an empty or stale gate list is only trustworthy while the writer runs)
